About.metaDescription: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that presents the geography of Türkiye and the world through free, sourced and accessible content.
About.heading: About
About.body1: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that aims to make geography free and accessible to everyone. Content is grounded in authoritative sources and passes an independent verification step before publication.
About.body2: The platform is under development. This page is a demonstration of the multilingual architecture and SEO foundations; content will deepen as coverage expands.

Game.metaDescription: A map game for finding Türkiye's 81 provinces and 7 geographical regions. Three modes: find the region, find all provinces, provinces by region. Free, no sign-up.
Game.heading: {brand} — Geography Map Game
Game.lede: {brand} is a find-the-place game played on the map of Türkiye. A province or region is named and you locate it on the map; when the round ends you see how many you got right and which provinces you missed.
Game.mode1Body: The seven geographic regions are asked in random order. Clicking any province of the region asked is enough.
Game.mode2Body: Every province is asked once, in random order. The ones you get right stay filled in for the rest of the round, so you watch the map fill up.
Game.mode3Body: You pick a region first, and then only the provinces of that region are asked. The round is as long as the number of provinces in your chosen region.
Game.mapHeading: The game map: the 81 provinces of Türkiye
Game.mapBody: Questions are asked on this map. Every shape is a province; the boundaries are generated from OpenStreetMap data.
Game.mapTitle: Map of the provinces of Türkiye (game area)
Game.howStep1: Pick one of the three game modes.
Game.howStep2: A province or region name appears; find it on the map and click it. You can zoom in when a province is too small to hit comfortably.
Game.howStep3: Every province starts at 100 points; each wrong click halves what that question is worth. If you cannot find it, press “Show the answer”: the question scores 0 and the round moves on. At the end you get a score out of 100 and a list of the provinces you missed, each linking to its own page.
Game.faq1Answer: Yes, entirely free. There is no payment, subscription or trial period.
Game.faq2Answer: No. The game runs without any sign-up; you can start playing as soon as the page opens.
Game.faq3Answer: Each round ends with a score out of 100. That score is kept only in the browser you played in and is never sent to a server; clearing your browser data clears it too. An unfinished round is kept in the same place, so you can pick an 81-question round back up where you left it.
Game.faq4Question: Where do the provinces and regions in the questions come from?
Game.faq4Answer: Province names and their regions come from the platform's own province database. The boundary lines on the map are generated from OpenStreetMap data. Each province has a detail page you can open from the map of Türkiye.

Climate.chartTitle: {name} — monthly mean temperature and precipitation chart
Climate.chartDesc: Monthly mean temperature ranges from {tempMin} to {tempMax} °C; the warmest month is {hottest} and the coldest is {coldest}. Monthly total precipitation ranges from {precipMin} to {precipMax} mm; the wettest month is {wettest} and the driest is {driest}. Columns show monthly total precipitation, the bold line shows monthly mean temperature, and the light band shows the monthly mean high–low temperature range.

Climate.sourceLine: Monthly normals: <mgm>MGM General Statistics table (k=A)</mgm>, {start}–{end} measurement period. Annual mean, total and seasonal percentage figures are computed by us from this series; they are not values published by MGM.

Dunya.metaDescription: Explore the countries of the world on an interactive map. Location, capital, population, area and physical geography — sourced, structured detail pages for each country.
Dunya.heading: World Map
Dunya.intro: Explore the countries of the world on an interactive map. Select a country to reach its sourced detail page covering location, capital, population and physical geography. Coverage begins with Türkiye's neighbouring countries and expands as new countries are added.

WorldMap.sectionHeading: Choose a country from the map
WorldMap.sectionBody: Hover a country on the map (or focus it with the keyboard) and follow the card to its detail page. Published countries are interactive; the remaining countries and regions light up as their content is added.
WorldMap.keyboardInstructions: When the map is focused, press + or = to zoom in and − to zoom out; use the arrow keys to pan and 0 or Home to return to the world view. With a mouse, scroll to zoom and drag to pan; on touch, pinch to zoom and drag with one finger to pan.

CountryDetail.sources: Data is grounded in official and authoritative sources: country and capital names from the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs; population from the World Bank (Geostat 2024 census for Georgia); area from the World Bank; continent and region classification from the UN Statistics Division (M49); neighbouring countries, government form, currency and physical geography from cross-checked multi-source references (Britannica and others).
